description: List every tool section with its current mode and the modes it accepts. Tiered sections (off / simple / full) and on/off sections can be widened with enable_tool_group and turned off with disable_tool_group. The "always" section is permanent. When a section changes, its tools appear in or leave tools/list and the SDK emits tools/list_changed so the client refreshes mid-conversation. Use this first to discover what is available before reaching for enable_tool_group.
name: list_tool_groups
title: List tool groups
